title: Zinc
body:
Description

Zinc is a type of that can spawn in Chalkyslate and Blueslate nodes.

The raw form of Zinc takes on a light gray color with a round shape. This can be mistaken for Iron, though it is lighter in color comparatively, more so with Tin - albeit containing more edges on the ore.

Putting Zinc in a refiner raises the sell price to $58 per stud. Putting that refined Zinc through a forge further increases the price to $70 per stud.

Like any other material in the game, you can use refined and forged Zinc to complete schematics.
